subject: Logic
title: Why Formal Logic Endures
description: Learn Why Formal Logic Endures in one minute.

hook.text: AI, circuits, law, philosophy—formal logic powers systems you use every day without realizing.

buildup.text: Every database query is logic. Every circuit gate is AND, OR, NOT. Every legal contract is an if-then chain.

discovery.text: Formal verification uses logic to prove software has zero bugs—before it even runs.

twist.text: Despite its limits (Gödel, undecidability), formal logic remains the most reliable reasoning tool we have.

climax.text: Where precision matters and ambiguity kills, formal logic is the language humans and machines share.

quiz.question: Where is formal logic used in technology?
